_meta.description: The lines this site covers, in hub order. Each line's facts live in src/data/lines/<id>/. project.json and stations.json are required; every other file is optional, and a section without its file does not show. 'alignment' names the GeoJSON file the map and schematic draw from. 'about' feeds the line's schema.org node on every page of that line. 'position_basis' names where station coordinates come from: 'by_source' matches part of a station's location source_url, else 'default'. 'copy' holds the line's own wording for shared pages; {total}, {km} and {name} are filled in. Tokens in copy: {stations}, {as_of}, {pct:<activity>}, {target}, {earlier}, {rest}, {alt}, {minutes} come from project.json. Keys ending in _html may contain inline markup. 'number' is the line's mark; 'colour' names its colour token in src/styles/tokens.css (with an on- token for text on it). Line 5 and Line 12 share orange, so every mention of a line shows its number with the colour (LineMark.astro).

about.name: Mumbai Metro Line 12
about.description: An elevated metro line under construction from Kalyan to Taloja in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, built by MMRDA.

copy.runs: which will run fully elevated from Kalyan to Taloja
copy.stations_section: All nineteen, in order from Kalyan. Names follow the civil contract. Select a station to ride to it, or open its own page.
copy.stations_page: All {total}, in order from Kalyan to Amandoot in Taloja. Every station is elevated. The line is {km} km long.
copy.stations_page_description: The {total} stations of {name} in order, from Kalyan through Dombivli MIDC and Nilje to Amandoot in Taloja, with interchanges and a page for each station.
copy.route_section: Nineteen stations, Kalyan to Amandoot. Scroll to ride the line station by station. Distances follow MMRDA's approved alignment of 20 March 2025.
copy.route_legend: A hollow line marks track that is under construction. No part of Line 12 has opened.
copy.headline_html:
Watch Mumbai Metro Line 12 rise,
pillar by pillar.
copy.front_standfirst: The line will run fully elevated from Kalyan through Dombivli MIDC, Kalyan Growth Centre and Turbhe to Amandoot in Taloja, with {stations} stations. On {as_of}, MMRDA put pile work at about {pct:Pile works} per cent and U-girder erection at about {pct:U-girder} per cent.
copy.target_html: Target: {target}, as reported in December 2025. Earlier reported target: {earlier}. MMRDA's project page gives no date.
copy.map_section: The line on a street map. Choose a station to see where it sits, what surrounds it and what the street looks like today. The route and stations come from MMRDA's approved alignment of 20 March 2025.
copy.map_legend: Route under construction, MMRDA's approved alignment

numbers.cost_note: MMRDA's loan invitation, March 2026. MMRDA's project page still gives ₹{alt} crore, the 2019 report's figure.
numbers.funding_note: In March 2026 MMRDA invited banks to lend ₹7,800 crore for Line 12, alongside fares and State support. No lender has been named yet.
numbers.travel_unit: Kalyan to Taloja; 50 to 75% shorter than by road today, depending on traffic (MMRDA estimates)

about.name: Mumbai Metro Line 5
about.description: A metro line from Thane through Bhiwandi and Durgadi to Kalyan in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, built by MMRDA in three phases. Phase 1, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, is built and awaiting trial runs.

by_source.x.com/Maha7Arindam: tentative key plan, MMRDA tender, Mar 2026

copy.runs: which will run from Thane through Bhiwandi to Kalyan, with a spur to Ulhasnagar
copy.stations_section: All {total} on the line, in order from Kapurbawdi, then the three on the Line 5A spur and the three the 2017 plan had. Names follow MMRDA. Select a station to ride to it, or open its own page.
copy.stations_page: All {total} on the line, in order from Kapurbawdi in Thane to Kalyan, then the Line 5A spur from Bhoirwadi to Ulhasnagar. Bhiwandi is underground; every other station is elevated. The line is {km} km long with the spur.
copy.stations_page_description: The stations of {name} in order, from Kapurbawdi in Thane through Bhiwandi and Durgadi to Kalyan, and the Line 5A spur to Ulhasnagar, with interchanges and a page for each station.
copy.route_section: Eighteen stations, Kapurbawdi to Kalyan, and the Line 5A spur to Ulhasnagar. Scroll to ride the line station by station. Distances follow MMRDA's alignment file of March 2025 to the Ulhas river bridge, and the tentative key plan of March 2026 past it.
copy.route_legend: A hollow line marks track that is not yet open, and a dashed outline the underground stretch. No part of Line 5 has opened.
drawn_from: of March 2025 and the tentative key plan of March 2026
copy.headline_html:
Watch Mumbai Metro Line 5 reach Kalyan,
phase by phase.
copy.front_standfirst: Phase 1, from Kapurbawdi in Thane to Dhamankar Naka in Bhiwandi, is built: on {as_of}, MMRDA's progress table showed every civil activity complete. Phases 2 and 3 take the line on to Kalyan, with a spur to Ulhasnagar: {stations} stations in all, as MMRDA counts them.
copy.target_html: Target: {target} for Phase 1, Kapurbawdi to Dhamankar Naka, from MMRDA's press release of May 2026. No exact date. The rest of the line: {rest}, as reported.
copy.map_section: The line on a street map. Choose a station to see where it sits, what surrounds it and what the street looks like today. The route to the Ulhas river bridge comes from MMRDA's alignment file of March 2025; Phase 3 and the spur come from the tentative key plan of March 2026.
copy.map_legend: Route not yet open: MMRDA's alignment file, then the tentative key plan

numbers.cost_note: Phase 1 ₹6,741 crore, Phase 2 ₹7,326 crore, Phase 5A (Phase 3 and the spur) ₹4,063 crore, MMRDA, May 2026.
numbers.funding_note: In April 2020 AIIB approved a loan concept of USD 236 million for the trains, signalling and power, with the OPEC Fund planned to lend too; MMRDA funds the rest. The final loan amounts are not published.
numbers.travel_unit: than by road, MMRDA's 2026 figure. Its Line 5 page still says 50 to 75%, from the 2017 plan.
